tools.description: Heuristically screen a smart contract on Ethereum or BNB Chain for risk signals from its on-chain bytecode and storage (e.g. selfdestruct_present, delegatecall_present, proxy_pattern_detected, centralized_ownership). Returns risk_signals, an assessment (minimal_risk / low_risk / medium_risk / high_risk / not_applicable / unknown), a human_summary, and a disclaimer. Heuristic screen only — not a formal audit or security advice.
tools.name: check_contract_risk

tools.description: Get current spot price, 24h change, market cap, and 24h volume for one or more cryptocurrency tokens (source: CoinGecko). Accepts token IDs or symbols (e.g. 'ethereum' or 'ETH'); unresolved tokens are reported in 'unresolved_tokens'. Informational only, not financial advice.

tokens.description: List of token IDs or symbols (e.g. 'ethereum' or 'ETH')

tools.name: check_token_price

tools.description: List an address's ERC-20/BEP-20 token holdings and native-coin balance on Ethereum or BNB Chain (source: Blockscout on Ethereum, BSCTrace on BNB Chain; native balance via RPC). Returns native_balance (wei), a tokens array (name, symbol, decimals, contract address, raw balance), token_count, and a human_summary. If the explorer is rate-limited, rate_limited=true and a reduced whitelist fallback is used (see note).
tools.name: check_token_holdings

tools.description: Estimate the gas and native-coin fee for a contract interaction on Ethereum or BNB Chain before sending it, via eth_estimateGas + eth_gasPrice. Requires to, from, and encoded call data (value optional, wei as decimal or 0x-hex). Returns estimated_gas, simulation_success, cost_breakdown (gas_estimate, gas_price_wei, gas_price_gwei, total_cost_wei, total_cost_eth (native-coin units), gas_limit_buffer), and a human_summary. On revert, simulation_success=false with a diagnosable error.

value.description: Amount of native token to send in wei (optional). Accepts decimal (e.g. '1000000000000000') or 0x-hex (e.g. '0x38d7ea4c68000')

tools.name: estimate_contract_interaction_cost

tools.description: Resolve an ENS (Ethereum Name Service) .eth domain to its Ethereum address (Ethereum mainnet only; not available on BNB Chain). Returns 'resolved_address' plus a 'human_summary'; if the name is invalid, unconfigured, or has no resolver, 'resolved_address' is empty and the reason is given in 'human_summary'.

ens_name.description: ENS domain name to resolve (e.g., vitalik.eth)

tools.name: resolve_ens_name

tools.description: List an address's NFT holdings (ERC-721/ERC-1155) on Ethereum or BNB Chain (source: Blockscout on Ethereum, BSCTrace on BNB Chain). Returns an nfts array (token_id, token_address, collection_name, token_name, token_type, metadata, image_url, quantity), total_count, and a human_summary. If the explorer is rate-limited, rate_limited=true and results may be incomplete.
tools.name: check_nft_holdings

tools.description: Query an address's native-transaction history on Ethereum or BNB Chain (source: Blockscout on Ethereum, BSCTrace on BNB Chain), newest first, paginated (page_size up to 10). Returns a transactions array (hash, block, timestamp, from, to, value, gas_used, gas_price, status, method), next_cursor, has_more, and a human_summary. Pass next_cursor back as 'cursor' to page. For token movements use query_token_transfers. On BNB Chain the data comes from BSCTrace, which is limited to roughly the last three months of blocks.

address.description: Address to query transaction history for

tools.name: query_address_history

tools.description: Trace value movements inside a transaction on Ethereum or BNB Chain: native-coin internal transfers (via debug_traceTransaction callTracer) and ERC-20/BEP-20 Transfer events. Returns native_transfers and token_transfers arrays (from, to, value, token_address), transfer_count, debug_available, and a human_summary. When the node lacks debug tracing, debug_available=false and only token transfers from receipt logs are returned.
tools.name: trace_internal_transfers

tools.description: Recommend gas prices for Ethereum or BNB Chain based on live gas price and fee-history congestion. Returns base_fee_gwei, network_congestion, basefee_trend, a recommendations map keyed slow/standard/fast (each with gas_price_gwei and estimated_time), and a human_summary. All prices are in gwei.
tools.name: recommend_gas_strategy

tools.description: Summarize an address's activity on Ethereum or BNB Chain: native-coin balance, total transaction (nonce) count, and recent ERC-20 activity (Transfer/TransferFrom/Approve) scanned over the last lookback_blocks blocks. Returns native_balance (human units), balance_wei, total_tx_count, a recent_erc20_activity array (type, block_number, transaction_hash, contract, direction), and a human_summary.

lookback_blocks.description: Number of recent blocks to analyze (default: 100)

tools.name: summarize_address_activity

tools.description: Report live network health for Ethereum or BNB Chain from recent blocks and fee history. Returns latest_block, avg_block_time_seconds, gas_utilization (0-1), base_fee_gwei, basefee_trend, congestion_level, and a human_summary. Takes only 'chain'.
tools.name: check_network_health

tools.description: Summarize a block on Ethereum or BNB Chain (by number, hex or decimal, or 'latest'). Returns block_number, timestamp (unix), transaction_count, gas_utilization_pct, top_transactions by gas (hash, from, to, gas_limit, gas_price, value_eth in native-coin units), and a human_summary. If the block is missing/invalid, an 'error' field explains why.
tools.name: summarize_block

tools.description: Analyze a cryptocurrency token's price trend over 7/30/90/365 days (source: CoinGecko): returns start/end/high/low price, percent change, and trend direction (up/down/sideways). Accepts a token ID or symbol (e.g. 'ethereum' or 'ETH'). Informational only, not financial advice.
tools.name: analyze_price_trend

tools.description: Inspect a smart contract's verification status and ABI on Ethereum (source: Blockscout). Returns is_verified, contract_name, the abi (when the contract is source-verified), and a human_summary. If the contract is unverified or not found, is_verified=false and abi is null. Ethereum only: BNB Chain has no contract-verification data source, so bsc requests return an explicit "not available" error.
tools.name: inspect_contract_interface

tools.description: Query an address's ERC-20/BEP-20 token-transfer history on Ethereum or BNB Chain (source: Blockscout on Ethereum, BSCTrace on BNB Chain), newest first, paginated; optionally filter by a token contract via token_address. Returns a transfers array (hash, block_number, timestamp, from_address, to_address, token_address, token_symbol, token_name, amount, decimals, type), next_cursor, has_more, and a human_summary. Pass next_cursor back as 'cursor' to page. On BNB Chain the data comes from BSCTrace, which is limited to roughly the last three months of blocks.

address.description: Address to query token transfers for

token_address.description: Specific token contract address to filter by

tools.name: query_token_transfers

tools.description: Diagnose the outcome of a transaction on Ethereum or BNB Chain by inspecting its receipt and replaying reverts via eth_call. Returns success (bool), failure_reason (e.g. out_of_gas, transaction_reverted, transaction_not_found), revert_message, gas_analysis (gas_used, gas_limit, gas_efficiency), and a human_summary. Works for both succeeded and failed transactions.
tools.name: diagnose_failed_transaction

tools.description: Summarize the overall cryptocurrency market (source: CoinGecko): total market cap (USD), BTC dominance, and the top N tokens by market cap (id, symbol, price, market cap, rank, 24h change). Takes no chain/token input. Informational only, not financial advice.

top_n.description: Number of top tokens to include
